items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: So after then, Frank Penae wrapped him up.

ctx.x: Now, didn't you, when did you stop booking Smith?

What happened after we cut the second record, or the thing that I used to do, well then it was time for a new contract. So maybe by then I'll tell you this on the tape, maybe I can't tell you. So after then, Frank Penae wrapped him up. He tucked him because I didn't have, my contract was out and he wouldn't renew it.
He wouldn't renew the contract. Now wait, now I didn't, I didn't bring the article with me, but I found something. Were you sued Slim? Right, right, right, right.
